entities.summary: Elten is a German village located in North Rhine-Westphalia. It has a population of around 4,500. Since 1975, it has been part of the town of Emmerich am Rhein. Between 1949 and 1963, Elten was part of the Netherlands. There is a substantial minority of Dutch citizens. Elten is a monastery in Europe, established in 968 CE.
